point_in_time_notes.full_daily_point_in_time: Membership refreshes semiannually, not daily — true daily point-in-time would require daily Nasdaq records
point_in_time_notes.membership_coverage_complete: True only if every official NDX symbol at every used snapshot is retained by provider coverage
point_in_time_notes.oos_membership_point_in_time: OOS test set uses NDX membership frozen at window start
point_in_time_notes.training_membership_asof_semiannual: Training membership is resolved from the latest semiannual NDX snapshot on or before each training date
point_in_time_notes.training_uses_future_oos_snapshot: Training never uses the future OOS-window snapshot — membership is strictly as-of each training date
